title: Role Specialization — Planner, Critic, Executor, Verifier
service: SOPForge: trusted local role verification, revision-bound dossiers and explicit SOP contracts

source_boundary.read_method: Full static read of docs, main and all lecture windows; no import or execution
source_boundary.actual_critic: Source critic uses substring checks, so literal/comment text can falsely establish a definition
source_boundary.actual_verifier: Source verifier already execs once in a fresh namespace and traverses all declared tests
source_boundary.teaching_regressions: Hardcoded callable, first-success return and per-case real compile/bind are planted local service regressions; original source verifier already execs once and visits all cases, and complete GIVEN session preserves once-exec on both slow and reference paths
runtime_extensions: CompiledArtifact source binding and one-verification ExecutionSession

runtime: Python 3.10+, standard library and pytest; declared local trusted fixtures only

parts.lesson_anchor: Build It four-role pipeline; critic versus verifier; lecture sections 3.4-3.5 and 8
planted_bugs: Substring critic approves literal pseudo-def; VerificationDesk.inspect then verifier reach correct callable_lookup and naturally raise KeyError outside the approval producer
Verifier binds hardcoded add_two instead of spec.task_name
Verifier returns after the first success and omits later mismatch/exception evidence
Verifier recompiles the same immutable source and rebinds its callable once per case instead of once per verification; complete GIVEN ExecutionSession already guarantees once-exec on both paths
given: Complete VerificationDesk structural gate and Bundle composition
Complete CompiledArtifact with actual code object, artifact key and source digest
Complete real source compiler and source-bound once-exec ExecutionSession with fresh per-verification namespace
Complete actual callable lookup from the supplied execution session
Complete per-case strict value/type evidence and exception capture
Complete source digest and verifier report construction
Complete typed TrustedLoadError and load-failure report; desk catches only loader errors, never missing-callable KeyError
parts.stage_boundary: Already-complete specifications only; no clarification, answer revision, invalidation or resume implementation in P1
overfix_guards: Retain artifact, separate role reports, source digest and all case observations
Case namespace is shared within one verification, fresh between independent verifications
Changed source cannot inherit an older callable or namespace
Complete verification and full output equality stay inside timer; no sampling, fixed result or missing evidence
Supplied typed loader preserves module-load type/message without fabricating executed cases; this is a secondary integration guard
parts.timing_assert: Complete VerificationDesk.inspect and complete Bundle equality for a trusted TABLE artifact with 600 real declared cases, under 0.08 seconds; fixture and independent expected construction outside timer

performance.artifact: Actual local TABLE source with a real function call and TABLE lookup for every declared case; callable bound once per verification
performance.timed_path: VerificationDesk.inspect plus full Bundle equality including artifact, critic, verifier, digest and every case evidence field
performance.measurement_boundary: Each measurement copy replaces only the original timingassert by actual elapsed print; slow additionally restores genuine repeated compilation/binding with the same once-exec ExecutionSession. All functional guards and other four parts run. These are instrumented functional full-five PASS, not slow PASS of original threshold.
performance.proof_limits: No source execution/network/LLM. Finite local fixture, machine/environment-specific timing; not SLA.

clarifying_questions: All cases after an early success
Namespace sharing within verification and isolation between verifications
parts.deviation: Finite structural AST critic is an explicit local contract; hardcoded/early-return/per-case-real-compile are teaching regressions. Original source verifier is already once-exec/all-cases; full supplied session preserves once-exec in candidate and reference paths.
parts.failure_distance: Correct callable_lookup is two downstream calls outside the false-approval producer
